fightSong.title: All In
fightSong.lyrics: Shuffle up and deal us in / Vegas lights, we always win / Cardsharks playing for the pot / Hit me once, give all you got!

stadium.name: The House
stadium.tradition: The Deal — a magician deals a giant card pre-game. If it's an ace, house always wins. It's always an ace. It's Vegas.

fanCulture.description: They bet on everything, including the coin toss. After touchdowns, confetti cannons shoot playing cards. What happens in Vegas stays, except losses.
fanCulture.tailgate: In a casino parking garage, obviously.

rivalries.name: The High Stakes
rivalries.narrative: Wall Street vs The Strip. They invest, we gamble.

cityFlavor: What happens here is broadcast nationally. Neon, noise, and no regrets.
